subject.title: fix(agents): prevent recursive task execution during model fallback

question: Should this PR land as a scoped embedded `sessions_spawn` fail-closed mitigation while gateway loopback, `sessions_send`/cron, and Codex-native spawn remain tracked by the canonical issue?
rationale: The patch changes fallback-turn delegation policy and deliberately leaves sibling work-spawning surfaces uncovered, so automation cannot choose the permanent scope or fail-closed boundary safely.

options.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
options.body: After the branch is refreshed cleanly, merge the embedded `sessions_spawn` guard and keep the canonical issue open for the remaining surfaces.

options.title: Harden More Surfaces First
options.body: Require this PR to also gate or explicitly thread policy through gateway loopback and `sessions_send`/cron before merge.

options.title: Pause For Shared Policy Seam
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose one common work-spawning policy boundary across OpenClaw tools and Codex-native delegation.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Mitigation
recommendation.body: After the branch is refreshed cleanly, merge the embedded `sessions_spawn` guard and keep the canonical issue open for the remaining surfaces.
